subject.title: fix(secrets): surface degradation in logs and doctor

question: Should this PR preserve non-missing SecretRef failure classes in the operator-facing redacted diagnostics before merging?
rationale: The intended redaction boundary is clear, but the protected maintainer label and secret-diagnostic surface warrant confirmation that the chosen sanitizer exposes the desired operational detail without exposing reference identity.

options.title: Fix redaction without flattening reasons
options.body: Redact the SecretRef identity while retaining distinctions such as missing, invalid resolved value, and denied environment reference, with focused regression tests.

options.title: Accept generic missing-reference wording
options.body: Keep the current conservative wording, accepting that some operators will receive an inaccurate recovery diagnosis.

recommendation.title: Fix redaction without flattening reasons
recommendation.body: Redact the SecretRef identity while retaining distinctions such as missing, invalid resolved value, and denied environment reference, with focused regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged owner-isolation and degraded-owner reporting model that defines this diagnostic boundary.
